scope: Offline unit tests of the read-only quota collector and existing smoke harness; no provider dispatch

attempts.failureTest: overall deadline cancels a stalled body and records all unstarted observations
attempts.diagnosis: The stream pulled before the collector acquired its reader. Deadline refusal after headers left that body uncancelled. Collector now retains/cancels the response before reader acquisition; stalled-body fixture waits for actual demand; a separate expired-header regression preserves this boundary.

tests: only seven exact authenticated GETs; retained IDs match both immutable smoke reports
every failure is retained without retries, including expired/denied records and remote exceptions
missing, negative, nonnumeric and unfinished durations never become zero or spending authority
declared and streamed response sizes are bounded and cancelled without reading raw errors
fragmented and empty chunks cannot expand retained buffering beyond the byte limit
a stalled fetch is aborted at the per-request deadline and is never retried
overall deadline cancels a stalled body and records all unstarted observations
synchronous work crossing either deadline is refused even before timer delivery
a response received at an expired boundary is cancelled before its body reader exists
quota CLI with missing credentials retains a failing report without opening a listener or provider connection
manual quota workflow defaults to read-only and has no device or tunnel action
selects physical phones, excludes beta/tablet/emulator entries, and supports unlisted Firefox
credentials stay in the HTTPS authorization header and remote error text is discarded
a wrong runner challenge fails and still deletes the allocated session
real-browser evidence is required and a teardown failure cannot produce a pass
session creation failures never echo the remote exception or claim cleanup
malformed success responses and a different Android browser do not pass

attempts.change: Use an immutable received-response local for strict narrowing; preserve outer cleanup reference and all request/abort behavior.

resourceControl.reason: All runs completed before a monitor sample; printed zero is not a measured zero-memory claim.

remaining: No quota admission or lifetime ledger
